_comment: LM doc-pack minimum requirements per NCCP / Best Interests Duty. Each category has items that must be satisfied. 'matches' arrays reference doc-type keys from doc-type-taxonomy.json; if ANY doc in the batch matches, the item is ticked. 'logic' = 'one-of' (at least one match satisfies) | 'all' (every match required) | 'count-N' (need N+ matching docs). SCOPE (v1.1.0, 20/08/2026): the LM source's 'Compliance documents' category (client-executed Privacy Consent, Game Plan, Quote) is deliberately absent here. Those are executed and stored in the CRM, outside the client's document folder, so this document audit never lists them and never calls them missing. Item wording for every remaining category stays verbatim from the LM source.

client_identification.label: Client identification

items.label: 2 forms of clear, legible ID for all applicants (at least 1 with current residential address)

notes: If original ID not sighted, must be certified by JP or Australia Post (in person or live video).
Smart Data Process IDs are treated as certified.
Lender's own ID policy may impose stricter requirements.

payg_income.label: PAYG income

items.label: 1 month bank statement <90 days with account name visible + confirming salary credits
1 payslip with 2+ pay cycles in YTD (most recent <60 days) OR employment letter / contract / payment summary / Tax Return / ATO NOA / ATO portal extract

notes: TFN must be redacted on all docs.
FOREIGN INCOME: also requires NAATI-translated payslips + employer letter + internet search of employer website.

self_employed_full_doc_sole_trader.label: Self-employed full doc — Sole Trader
self_employed_full_doc_sole_trader.applicable_when: applicant is sole trader on full doc loan

items.label: ONE of: Tax portal 12mo statements / 12mo BAS / 2nd year Tax Return + financials

self_employed_full_doc_partnership.label: Self-employed full doc — Partnership
self_employed_full_doc_partnership.applicable_when: applicant is in a partnership on full doc loan

items.label: ONE of: Tax portal 12mo / 12mo BAS / 2nd year TR + financials

self_employed_full_doc_company.label: Self-employed full doc — Company
self_employed_full_doc_company.applicable_when: applicant is director of a company on full doc loan

items.label: ONE of: Tax portal 12mo / 12mo BAS / 2nd year TR + financials
Evidence of GST registration + ABN search (6+ months) + 24mo industry experience
Evidence of GST registration + ABN search (6+ months) + 24mo industry experience
ONE of: 6mo BAS / 6mo business account statements
ONE of: tenancy agreement / rental statement / 3mo bank stmts showing rent receipt (<60 days) / valuation report / signed rental estimate
ONE of: Centrelink statement (<60 days) / 3mo bank stmts showing income (<60 days)

investment_income.label: Investment income (dividends / interest)
investment_income.applicable_when: applicant has dividend or interest income

items.label: Most recent full Tax Return + ATO Final NOA
Payment statements OR 3mo bank stmts showing receipt (<60 days)

living_expenses.label: Living expenses

items.label: 3mo statements of ALL relevant bank + credit card accounts (<60 days, account name visible)
Rent-free letter from property owner (if applicable)

notes: All expenses must be entered in MyCRM / Online Fact Find.

items.label: ONE of: CSA Notice / Court order / 3mo bank stmts showing payment (<60 days)

existing_liabilities_not_refinanced.label: Existing liabilities NOT being refinanced
existing_liabilities_not_refinanced.applicable_when: applicant has existing liabilities (CC, PL, HL, car loan, etc.)

items.label: Account statement <60 days (with account name) OR CCR (3mo conduct, latest <45 days)

miscellaneous_liabilities.label: Miscellaneous Liabilities (ATO + BNPL)
miscellaneous_liabilities.applicable_when: applicant has ATO debts or BNPL accounts

items.label: Copy of ATO debts from ATO portal
Copy of BNPL current balance (Afterpay / Zip / Klarna / etc.)

refinancing.label: Refinancing — liabilities being refinanced / consolidated
refinancing.applicable_when: loan purpose includes refinance or debt consolidation

items.label: Most recent 3mo account statements (<60 days) OR CCR (3mo conduct, latest <45 days)
Evidence of funds to complete OR statutory declaration / gift letter
3mo bank stmts showing repayment history (<60 days) if loan on property
Client signed + dated lender Privacy Consent
File notes capturing all client + lender interactions
All email communications to lender and client
Super statement OR ATO portal super balance (if needed for exit strategy)

trusts.label: Trusts
trusts.applicable_when: applicant is a trustee or trust beneficiary

items.label: ONE of: Tax portal 12mo / 12mo BAS / 2nd year TR + financials

reverse_mortgages.label: Reverse Mortgages

items.label: Reverse Mortgage Information statement provided to clients
Equity projections (MoneySmart-generated) provided before Game Plan

notes: Reverse Mortgage accreditation is required to sell this product.

consumer_asset_personal_loans.label: Consumer asset finance / personal loans
consumer_asset_personal_loans.applicable_when: loan is for asset finance or personal loan

items.label: Tax invoice of asset being purchased (if secured)
Client-executed Quote (if brokerage / origination fee charged)
Certificate of Registration of security (if required by lender)
